claim.claim-text: 1. A communication apparatus that performs wireless communication according to Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, IEEE 802.11 standard, the communication apparatus comprising:
2. The communication apparatus according to Claim 1, wherein a period for performing the sensing in the sensing means is based on a SIFS period.

3. The communication apparatus according to Claim 1 or 2, wherein the transmission control means performs control such that the communication apparatus transmits a signal on one or more resource units in a case where no energy sensing is made on the communication channel.
4. The communication apparatus according to any one of Claim 1 to 3, wherein transmitting a signal includes sending data to the access point.
5. The communication apparatus according to any one of Claim 1 to 4, further comprising a screen that displays data.
6. The communication apparatus according to Claim 5, wherein the screen provides a graphical user interface based on user pointing operation.
7. The communication apparatus according to any one of Claim 1 to 6, wherein an application program that receives a video stream is stored in a storage device of the communication apparatus.

8. A method for transmitting a signal, the method being performed at a communication apparatus that performs wireless communication according to Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, IEEE 802.11 standard, and the method comprising:

9. A non-transitory computer-readable medium storing a program which, when executed by a microprocessor or computer system in a communication apparatus, causes the communication apparatus to perform the method of claim 8.
10. A communication apparatus that performs wireless communication according to Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, IEEE 802.11 standard, the communication apparatus comprising:

a transmission means for transmitting a trigger frame including first information indicating a plurality of resource units splitting a communication channel in a frequency domain and second information for determining whether a sensing of energy of the communication channel is required, wherein, a trigger frame that includes information indicating that a sensing of energy of a communication channel is required is a control frame that causes at least one other communication apparatus identified by an AID (Association ID) included in the trigger frame to perform a first control action for sensing the energy of the communication channel.

11. The communication apparatus according to claim 10, wherein the trigger frame is a control frame further causing at least one other communication apparatus to perform a second control action for transmitting a signal on one or more resource units in a case where the energy sensed by the at least one other communication apparatus which has been caused to perform the first control action does not exceed a specific threshold.

12. The communication apparatus according to claim 11, wherein the trigger frame further includes information related to a timing at which the transmission of the signal by other communication apparatus is to be stopped.
13. The communication apparatus according to Claim 1, wherein the trigger frame further includes information corresponding to the specific threshold.

14. A method for controlling a communication apparatus that performs wireless communication according to Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, IEEE 802.11 standard, the method comprising:

transmitting a trigger frame including first information indicating a plurality of resource units splitting a communication channel in a frequency domain and second information for determining whether a sensing of energy of the communication channel is required, wherein, a trigger frame that includes information indicating that a sensing of energy of a communication channel is required is a control frame that causes at least one other communication apparatus identified by an AID (Association ID) included in the trigger frame to perform a first control action for sensing the energy of the communication channel.

15. A non-transitory computer-readable medium storing a program which, when executed by a microprocessor or computer system in a communication apparatus, causes the communication apparatus to perform the method of claim 14.
